points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段时间短且淘汰赛风险偏好下降，仍平是基础高概率分支。
points.rationale_en: Extra time is short and knockout risk appetite usually falls, so remaining level is the base high-probability branch.

points.rationale_cn: Spain凭借体能、替补或反击效率在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: Spain win by one goal in extra time through fitness, substitutes, or counterattack efficiency.

key_factors.impact_cn: 加时只在90分钟打平后触发；常规时间模型为Portugal胜28.8%、平28.4%、Spain胜42.8%，说明Spain更强但并非压倒性打穿。
key_factors.impact_en: Extra time is only triggered if it is level after 90 minutes; the regular-time model gives Portugal 28.8%, draw 28.4%, Spain 42.8%, suggesting Spain are stronger but not overwhelmingly dominant.

key_factors.impact_cn: 若高温或强度累积让Portugal防线与中场横移下降，Spain可通过控球、半空间推进和边路宽度获得加时小幅优势。
key_factors.impact_en: If heat or accumulated intensity reduces Portugal’s defensive and midfield lateral movement, Spain can gain a slight extra-time edge through possession, half-space progression, and wide play.

key_factors.impact_cn: Portugal的加时路径是中低位压缩、定位球高点和反击速度点，并接受把比赛拖向点球；但需确认场上是否仍保留这些资源。
key_factors.impact_en: Portugal’s extra-time route is a compact mid-to-low block, set-piece aerial targets, and pace on the counter, while accepting a path toward penalties; but it must be confirmed whether these resources are still on the pitch.
